about: Cambridge is the southern city of Waterloo Region, at the confluence of the Grand and Speed rivers. It was formed by amalgamating Galt, Preston, and Hespeler. Stone mill buildings in Galt and older factory towns still give each former community its own downtown. About 140,000 people live in Cambridge.
seoSummary: Waterloo Region river city amalgamated from Galt, Preston, and Hespeler.
